d: 🌟 We're Hiring: Network Engineering Director / Network Architect / Senior Network Engineer

We are a technology-driven organization focused on designing, developing, and maintaining reliable digital infrastructure for modern businesses. Our network engineering initiatives support secure connectivity, scalable enterprise environments, and high-performance communication systems. Through technical innovation, infrastructure planning, and operational excellence, we aim to help organizations strengthen their digital capabilities and adapt to evolving technology demands.

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineering Director / Network Architect / Senior Network Engineer to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across network infrastructure initiatives. This position involves overseeing network design strategies, evaluating infrastructure performance, supporting technology improvements, and coordinating engineering activities. Working remotely on a part-time basis, you will collaborate with IT professionals and business stakeholders to develop secure, scalable, and efficient network solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
Lead network engineering initiatives and provide technical direction for assigned projects.
Design and review scalable network architectures based on business and operational requirements.
Oversee network infrastructure planning, implementation, and optimization activities.
Evaluate network performance, availability, capacity, and overall reliability.
Establish practical standards for network design, configuration, and technical documentation.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, and IT operations teams.
Assess network security risks and recommend appropriate infrastructure improvements.
Guide engineering teams in troubleshooting complex network issues.
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for network modernization.
Prepare technical assessments, project updates, and recommendations for stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 3+ years of relevant professional experience preferred.
Strong understanding of enterprise networking, infrastructure architecture, and connectivity solutions.
Knowledge of routing, switching, LAN, WAN, wireless networking, and network security.
Familiarity with network architecture design, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
Understanding of cloud networking and modern hybrid infrastructure environments.
Ability to evaluate technical requirements and develop scalable network solutions.
Strong technical leadership, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.
Ability to coordinate technical projects and work independently in a remote environment.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation aligned with technical expertise and responsibilities.
Opportunities to contribute to enterprise network architecture and infrastructure projects.
Exposure to international technology initiatives and modern networking solutions.
Professional growth through technical leadership and strategic project involvement.
A collaborative environment that values engineering excellence and continuous innovation.

r: We're seeking a People Business Partner for our People team. As a People Business Partner, you will be crucial in providing tactical and strategic consulting on people and organization development strategies in support of the business objectives.

Drawing on your proficiency in contributing to the development and implementation of HR policies and programs, you will be responsible for carrying out the following functional areas: employee relations consultation, policy interpretation and application, performance and compensation management consultation, talent management consultation to create unique experiences only Tamara can provide.

With a proven track record of strong understanding of HR principles, practices, and regulations, excellent communication, interpersonal, problem-solving skills, and ultimately revolutionize the way millions of users shop, pay, and bank.

You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges.

You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success.
Provide HR partnership and support for strategic and tactical initiatives, including day-to-day HR assistance and strategy execution for assigned business groups.
Foster and maintain effective relationships with leaders and employees, offering guidance on HR and business issues at all levels.
Influence and coach leaders and managers to achieve business objectives within the assigned populations.
Manage employee relations and act as a change agent by implementing best practices and improving work relationships.
Manage talent development and succession planning, including identifying performance gaps and training needs for departments, managers, and employees within assigned business groups.

Implement HR best practices for key HR processes, such as performance management, compensation planning, workforce/capability planning, and talent management.
Identify training, coaching, and mentoring needs for departments, managers, and employees.
Partner with other HR team members, including International HR, Immigration, and Payroll, acting as a point of contact and liaison with supported groups to deliver comprehensive HR services.
Bachelor's degree in human resources, business or related field.
Previous experience in coaching employees and management through complex, difficult issues.
Proven strong foundation and knowledge of principles & practice of HR including employment law & compliance requirements.

Ability to thrive in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.
Ability to set high personal goals and work independently Ability to organize, multi-task and prioritize tasks.

Practical IFRS and multi-entity accounting experience. Microsoft Dynamics experience is a plus.
